newsitem.title: USA: Chase files shelf for 300,000 series C pfd.
newsitem.headline: Chase files shelf for 300,000 series C pfd.

text.p: A trust formed by Chase Manhattan Corp filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 300,000 global floating rate capital securities, series C.
The trust, known as Chase Capital III, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of its parent, the New York-based bank holding company.
Proceeds from the sale of the debentures will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the repurchase or redemption its outstanding common and preferred stock.
The total maximum offering is valued at $300 million, the filing said.
